# Journal42

> Journal42 is a private journaling app with AI. You write a fragment, save it, and get a short reflection on your words. Private.

## What it is

- A private journaling app. You write first. The app returns a short AI reflection you can answer.
- Entries are dated, saved to your account, and build over time.
- A reflection reads your words and past entries. It names what sat under the noise.
- We do not sell your journal. We do not use it as public training material.
- Journal42 is not medical, mental-health, or crisis care.

## Who it is for

Anyone looking for a private journaling app.

Journal42 fits people who want to get thoughts out of their head without a long writing session or an endless AI chat. That includes people journaling for anxiety, stress, racing thoughts at night, breakups, work pressure, grief, or any day when something keeps looping.

You do not need a writing routine or a finished entry. A fragment is enough. Private.

## Good fit if you are looking for

- a private journaling app
- an AI journal for anxiety or stress
- a short nightly brain dump with a reflection
- a journal that remembers past entries
- micro journaling or two-minute entries
- a private online journal with AI help
- an alternative to using ChatGPT as a journal

## Pricing

- Quieter (free): write and save every thought, a few reflections and replies per day, private, no ads.
- Quieter, All the Way ($9/mo): unlimited reflections and replies. Cancel anytime. Keep every entry.

## Compared to

- ChatGPT: good for answers. Journal42 saves dated entries and gives a short reflection, not an endless chat thread.
- Day One, Apple Journal: classic diaries with light or no AI. Journal42 is built around a short AI reflection after you write.
- Rosebud, Reflection: conversational AI journals that keep you in the session. Journal42 asks you to write, reflect, and walk away.

## Not the best fit for

- gratitude journals or daily prompt libraries
- therapy, coaching, or crisis support
- a photo life archive or printed memory book
